verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository (github.com/temporalio/temporal) whose README covers building, installing, and running the server, and notes the project originated as a fork of Uber's Cadence. Together with the self-hosting guide, this shows the server source is publicly readable. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open license (e.g. MIT/Apache LICENSE file), coverage of SDK repos, independent corroboration of license terms.
